title: Ultra-high surface area silica material and its application for selective N-formylation using a CO2 surrogate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1900-1911
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07379K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Anwar, Soyeb Pathan, Pogula Sreekanth Reddy, Janarthanan Ponraj, Sarim Dastgir
Ultra-high surface area mesoporous QSM silica synthesised at room temperature catalyses N-formylation of amines using formic acid under mild, solvent-free conditions, providing a sustainable, metal-free method for amide bond formation.
